notes.title: Patch note Ver 0.602 is now available!
notes.notes:
We have partially updated the UI of the home screen and world map!
We hope it has become a little easier to play. (I know it's still not enough...)
We plan to update the UI for a while, then update the features and fix bugs.

Patch Notes

UI & EFFECT
Fixed layout of home screen
Changed background of home screen
Added help display to world map

notes.title: Small Update! Patch note Ver. 0.601 is now available!
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas! 
How are you all doing?

Although this update has nothing to do with Christmas, we have also made a small update to BitOz!
Our plan for the future is to make small updates to BitOz every week for a while.
We will continue to improve the balance, UI, and production aspects of the game little by little, so please give us your support!

Patch Notes

UI & EFFECT 
Fixed HP gauge behavior
Fixed ExitUI in the store
Fixed UI for returning to Oz update/player data screen

SYSTEM UPDATE
Added ability to pause during battle

notes.title: Major Update! Patch note Ver 0.60 is now available!
notes.notes:
Happy Black Friday! How are you all doing?

We're a little late to the party, but Bit Oz is also getting a major update just in time for Black Friday!
As we had announced (albeit quite late...), we have implemented World 2 and adjusted the game balance!
In addition to a new map shape, more powerful enemies have been introduced! Dive into the depths of the new Cyber Eden!

At the same time, we are having a sale! Please take this opportunity to play!

Patch Notes

SYSTEM UPDATE
World 2 has been added

BUG FIXES
Bombtopus: shot behavior fixed

BALANCE 
Bombtopus: HP increased
Popstar: Speed reduced Damage multiplier reduced Shot size reduced
Humpty: Damage multiplier increased Shot speed increased
Double shot: Size increased
Triple shot: Increased size

UI & EFFECT 
Battle UI: Show control buttons

notes.title: Patch Note v0.5.1 Update!!
notes.notes:
Hello! Dear Oz! 

It's been a few days since the Early Access release, and now that the game has been released on TOKYOOSANDOBOX, we're back at it again!
This time, we have fixed some of the known bugs that were fatal to the gameplay!

Our plan for future updates is to fix critical bugs and add new elements in a short span of time, while making major updates in a longer span of time.

We will also be releasing a list of bugs that have not been addressed in the near future (we apologize for the delay!).

We will continue to make updates so that you can continue to play Bit Oz comfortably and enjoyably!
We will see you again in the next update!

BUG FIXES.
BATTLE CHEAT: Invisible hit when firing double comet
BATTLE RESULTS: Changed display of ant scores shown in item list
